notes:
v0.1.8 — Clipboard image paste to guest (for Claude attachments):
- Ctrl+Shift+V in any terminal: if Windows clipboard has an image, save it to %USERPROFILE%\.winmux-clipboard\paste-TIMESTAMP.png and inject the guest path /workspace/.winmux-clipboard/paste-... — Claude Code picks it up as attachment
- Command palette: 📋 Paste clipboard image to guest
- Solves 'No image found in clipboard. You're SSH'd; try scp?' error
